content.stem_en: Which of the following risk factors are commonly associated with money laundering in insurance products? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Surrendering a policy early to liquidate funds
options_en.B: Focusing excessively on the investment performance of an insurance product
options_en.C: Using a credit card to purchase an insurance policy
options_en.D: Having an unrelated third party pay large or excessive premiums for the insurance policy
